description.label: Description
description.value:
Going in just under the lower ribs, the bullet shreds one of your kidneys. This results in massive blood loss as the kidney’s job is to filtrate your entire blood volume over and over again. You’ll be emptied out in no time!

Effects: Gain @Condition[Stunned] (1) and @Condition[Bleeding] (3), the latter of which requires Surgery to remove.

Surgery (Very Hard) is required for Extraction, which will count as resolving an internal issue due to the bullet being lodged inside a body cavity.
